children: The total on-chain circulating market capitalization of stablecoins fell to $284.215 billion, a new low for the year and about $30.2 billion below its May 17 peak of $314.392 billion. According to Odaily, the market cap declined 1.61% over the past seven days and 6.15% over the past 30 days. It continued to fall in the fourth quarter, reaching $298.741 billion at the end of October and $288.020 billion on November 18.

title: Stablecoin Market Cap Falls to $284.215 Billion, a Yearly Low, Down About $30.2 Billion From May Peak
